description: Mark an invoice as sent without emailing anything (send types: PDF download, print, postal — deliberately no email). Refuses enshrined invoices and verifies the result. Honors SEVDESK_DRY_RUN. ⚠️ This tool can change data in sevDesk.

dryRun.description: Preview the request without sending it.

sendType.description: How the invoice left the house (default VPDF).

name: sevdesk_mark_invoice_sent
title: Mark an invoice as sent
